body.sql:
SELECT c.* FROM contacts c
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
              WHERE s.contact_id = c.id AND s.topic_id = ?1 AND s.state = ?2)
  AND (max(coalesce(c.last_event_at, 0), coalesce(c.last_opened_at, 0), coalesce(c.last_clicked_at, 0)) >= ?3
       OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e
           WHERE e.contact_id = c.id AND e.name = ?4 AND e.at >= ?5) >= ?6
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages_out m
                  WHERE m.contact_id = c.id AND m.stream = 'campaign'
                    AND m.first_clicked_at IS NOT NULL AND m.created_at >= ?7))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages_out m
              WHERE m.contact_id = c.id AND m.campaign_id = ?8 AND m.first_opened_at IS NOT NULL)
  AND json_extract(c.fields, '$.country') COLLATE NOCASE IN (?9, ?10, ?11)
